name: app-shater-billboard-mockup-services-start-from-shater
title: Shater outdoor billboard mockup: 'Your services start from Shater' with stacked phone screens at dusk
whatItIs: A photo-realistic street billboard at dusk in navy with a weathered 'Shater' wordmark, an Arabic headline 'خدمتك تبدأ من شاطر' (Your service starts from Shater), a supporting line, App Store and Google Play badges, and three stacked phone screens showing the app in front of the sign.
whatItMeans: Aspirational and real-world; an outdoor ad mockup extends the brand from screens into the physical city.
techniques: Mock the brand onto real-world outdoor media.
Weather the wordmark texture for authenticity.
Angle phone screens in front of the billboard for scale.

vocabulary.definition: A realistic preview of an ad on outdoor signage.
